color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
L1 · SESSION STATE — Agent Engine
─────────────────────────
in-flight reasoning for a single agent turn
tool-call scratchpad, partial parses
Lifetime — the turn
Answers — what am I doing right now?

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
L2 · DURABLE LEDGER — Firestore
─────────────────────────
reviews · completed_steps · step_results · events
findings · qa_responses · screenings · approvals
idempotency keys · score breakdowns
Lifetime — forever, immutable
Answers — what happened, exactly?

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Distillation, at review close
and at notable events only
write what changes a future decision —
outcome, negotiated exceptions,
conduct flags, contact changes

div.style: color: rgb(88, 28, 135) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
L3 · VENDOR MEMORY — Memory Bank
─────────────────────────
vendor dossier — prior reviews, negotiated exceptions,
contacts, the adversarial conduct flag
org policy memory — we always require SOC 2 Type II
for data processors
Lifetime — across reviews and years
Answers — what is worth knowing next time?

div.style: color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The anti-pattern
dumping the whole review transcript into memory
turns L3 into a slower, dumber L2

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The payoff, on review two
months later the fleet opens the second review
with the prior negotiation history already in hand —
and a vendor's adversarial flag still attached

svg.text: Drawbridge — Memory hierarchy: persistence is not memory
